Live sound, held in person

An hour of sound where nothing is asked of you. You lie down, you stay warm, and the room does the rest. Offered to groups, to teams, and to one person at a time.

See the offerings

What a session is

In the room

Seven Tibetan singing bowls, played live. You lie on a mat under a blanket and listen. There is nothing to learn beforehand and nothing to perform.

Who comes

People who meditate daily and people who never have. Teams at the end of a long quarter. Couples, birthdays, farewells. No experience needed.

How to begin

Bring sound to your own room — an office, a studio, a living room, a retreat. Send a message with a date and a rough headcount.

You're not being asked to believe anything.
You're being asked to lie down and listen.

Sound for teams

A session runs 45 to 90 minutes and needs only floor space and a door that closes. Away days, launch weeks, wellbeing programmes, or an ordinary Thursday afternoon.
